''See also: [[Regents Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Regents are four exceptionally powerful individuals who serve as the primary representatives of the Emperor. Historically, they were the personal companions and peers of the Emperor, possessing legendary status and power levels that rivaled his own. Known for their ability to emerge from long periods of hibernation or sleep to defend humanity, they have historically intervened during times of great crisis, such as suppressing major rebellions or opposing the [[Great Elders]]. Following the death of the Emperor, the Regents took control to maintain stability, though they have refused to take the throne themselves, maintaining that only a true Emperor can rule. In their current capacity, they have divided [[The Empire|the Empire]] into four distinct regions. The known Regents include [[Estyr Six]], [[Loreli]], [[Alagaeus]] of the East, and [[Jorin Curse-breaker]] of the South. While they act as pillars for the [[Independent Guilds]] and are viewed by some as essential protectors, their role is controversial; they have been accused of undermining the political influence and capital of certain [[Guilds]], such as the [[Consultants]]. While their intended function is to serve as warriors against cosmic threats, their governance has led to concerns that the unified Empire is fracturing into separate kingdoms.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Regents are a group of four [[Imperial]] heroes who were awakened by [[Shera]]. Following the death of the Emperor, these individuals sought to ensure [[The Empire|the Empire]] remained in a state of anarchy. To achieve their ends, they divided the world into four distinct regions, placing [[The Empire|the Empire]] under their respective control. Their presence and influence are a source of fear for [[Yala the High Mason|Yala]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Yala the High Mason|Yala]] is afraid of the [[Regents]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c2">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The [[Regents]] wanted [[The Empire|the Empire]] to remain in anarchy following the Emperor's death.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c13">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The [[Regents]] are four [[Imperial]] heroes who were woken by [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c15">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[The Empire]] is divided into regions under four [[Regents]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c17">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The [[Regents]] split the world into four.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c26">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 26</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|As the four most powerful individuals in the world, the Regents represent a group that requires constant control. They were provoked by certain parties for calculated reasons, even as they remained potentially unaware of specific movements occurring around them. While the populace might eventually look to this group for defense rather than the [[Guilds]], some [[Champions]] argue that [[The Empire|the Empire]] should instead be governed by separate regions under the [[Authority|authority]] of the Regents.}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Regents are a powerful group within [[The Empire|the Empire]] possessing the ability to read shady backgrounds. While two of the three members originally sealed the [[peace accords]], they later attacked the [[Imperial Steward]] under a flag of truce. Following a period where only two active Regents remained in the absence of an Emperor, they eventually agreed to attempt a plan proposed by [[Calder]]. During a battle between [[Kelarac]] and the Regents, the group was seen floating in the air while fighting [[bronze effigies]]. Ultimately, four Regents were cast in bronze to stand guard over [[Kelarac]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">14</span></div>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Regents are four companions of the Emperor within the [[Aurelian Empire]] who remain asleep in coffins until they are required to defend humanity. Connected to the [[Mistress of the Mists]], these figures were freed by [[Shera]] and serve as a group to whom she demonstrates [[Consultant]] assets. Although they possess the power to wage war and could potentially depose the [[Consultants]], they were notably absent from a specific meeting. While exploring their tomb, [[Lucan]] and [[Shera]] are forced to face the frozen Regents, who eventually provide firsthand accounts of the [[Elder War]]. During a time of conflict, three of the Regents engage [[Kelarac]] and appear to maintain control, while bronze statues of the four Regents of [[Beldin]] later drop from holes in the sky to fight against [[Nakothi]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">27</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Regents]] are a group that [[Shera]] is demonstrating [[Consultant]] assets to.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Regents]] must approve the organization of the meeting.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Regents]] may wage war to the full extent of their powers.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Regents]] are companions of the Emperor who sleep until needed to defend humanity.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c7">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Regents]] are connected to the [[Mistress of the Mists]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c9">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor knows the [[Regents]] personally.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13" />}}</li>
